thread:
jana: FYI customers reporting odd quota attribution - requests proxied via proxy-C show quota hitting the SA owner project.
omar: can you paste an example request?
jana: sure:
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer sa-impersonate-token
X-Proxy-Id: proxy-C
X-Impersonate-Project: proj-proxy-C
```
lucy: are proxies exchanging tokens currently?
omar: most proxies do exchange, but proxy-C is doing pass-through for low-latency. backend auth uses token.owner_project so attribution goes to proj-main.
jana: want attribution to reflect the proxied tenant not SA owner. options: 1) require exchange, 2) accept signed origin header, 3) map proxy mTLS cert to tenant.
lucy: exchange is safest but adds ~12ms. signed header HMAC is low-latency but needs nonce and rotation. cert mapping is nice if proxy fleet uses mTLS.
omar: console request: can we show both "token_owner" and "effective_origin" in dashboards so SREs can spot drift?
console-team: yes. we'll add a per-proxy drift metric and a small panel: drift %, top routes, and recent mismatches.
jana: propose pilot: accept signed header `X-Redwood-Origin` + `X-Redwood-Origin-Sig` (HMAC SHA256 with timestamp+nonce). gate acceptance behind console flag per-proxy. emit metrics: auth.origin.accepted, auth.origin.rejected, auth.origin.replay.
olra: infra-bot: rolling deploy queued: auth-service@origin-sig-check -> canary staging.
omar: add nonce cache TTL 60s to catch replays. also log rejected signatures with sample rate 1% to avoid log noise.
lucy: we'll need a clear rollback: if auth.origin.rejected rate > 0.2% or auth.latency.p95 increases > 15ms, flip flag off.
jana: ok I'll write the spec and open PRs for auth + proxy changes. console-team will mock the panel and add a per-proxy toggle.
console-team: mock ready, posting in #design now. :rocket:
infra-bot: canary finished: auth-service@origin-sig-check -> staging (status: success).
omar: will monitor metrics and post back in 1h.
jana: thanks all — this should reduce accidental quota drains and make billing clearer.
